And what's with this anger over not getting the backer rewards? The backer rewards, by his own admission, are rewards for donating to the funding of the game, which he admits have all been refunded! You can have the backer rewards, or you can have the money you donated to the game development, but by the very logic of backer rewards, you cannot have both the backer rewards AND the money you donated to game development. Sargon took the only logical, and dare I say, ethical choice, in refunding his backers money when the project finally fell through.

He then goes on to rail about the fact that Sargon has a Patreon, as many other prominent YouTubers do, and claims that it "literally gives nothing to the public in exchange for financing him" despite the fact that said Patreon is supposed to fund the very videos he publishes, as a product for consumption, thereby literally giving the public something, making this rant, yet again, nonsensical and sounding mentally unbalanced.

He overextended his promises, he realized he dun goofed, he issued a cancellation-statement as well as refunds while under no obligation to (Kickstarter's TaS page is quite clear that projects may never actually come to fruition).

Even with a creator's best efforts, a project may not work out the way everyone hopes. Kickstarter creators have a remarkable track record, but nothing's guaranteed.

In short, Sargon has gone above-and-beyond what is necessary on his end of things to make things right with the backers of his failed project.
